# RABNIX — High-Precision Digital Engines

> An elite digital engineering firm. We construct bespoke websites, tailored CRM platforms, robust custom software, and complex AI Agent workforces that operate at peak efficiency.

## About
RABNIX engineers high-precision digital systems for organizations across defense, finance, health, energy, edtech, logistics, retail, government, and media sectors. Founded in 2025, we have deployed 50+ engineered systems across 12 industries.

## Services
- **Web Development** — Bespoke high-performance web systems engineered for maximum conversion using React, Next.js, and FastAPI.
- **CRM Development** — Tailored hub architectures that centralize operations, automate lead routing, and provide granular analytics.
- **AI Workflow Automation** — Custom agent chains that automate complex workflows end-to-end using n8n, Make, and custom middleware.
- **AI Agents** — Self-optimizing autonomous digital workforce utilizing cutting-edge LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini) to handle support, research, and operations.
- **Custom Software** — Full-stack applications, dashboards, and internal tools built to spec.
- **Digital Marketing** — Data-driven campaigns optimized for conversion across search and social.
- **Enterprise Integrations** — Connect disparate tools into a unified operational layer.

## Pricing
One-time packages starting from $299 (Launch) to $1,199 (Revenue Engine). All packages include SSL, analytics, free domain and hosting (1 year), and 6 months post-delivery support.
